values.description: FacilityService HTTP endpoint. Verified from src/Services/FacilityService/SmartParking.FacilityService.API/Properties/launchSettings.json (profile `http`). Serves GET /api/parking-lots/{id}/operational-layout and the internal /internal/gate-sites/{siteId}/slots/** routes.
UserService. Used for POST /api/auth/login and the operator scope reads GET /api/operators/site-scope and GET /api/operators/slot-scope. No FacilityService route is involved.

OperationService (the repository still names this URL reservationServiceUrl for parity with SPARK-238). Serves the gate/session REST routes that write the SPARK-244 outbox rows: /api/parking-sessions/walk-in/check-in, /api/parking-sessions, /api/parking-sessions/{id}/walk-in/check-out. Verified from the OperationService launchSettings.json (profile `http`).
Seeded demo Owner (SMARTPARK_OWNER_EMAIL). Holds the demo tenant a0000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001, so it can read the telemetry (unredacted) operational layout for seededSiteId.
Copy SMARTPARK_OWNER_PASSWORD from the repository root .env. Never commit the real value.

Seeded demo Operator (SMARTPARK_OPERATOR_EMAIL). scripts/database/seeds/demo/01-identity.sql assigns the account to the demo site and grants SLOT_OVERRIDE, so both site-scope and slot-scope return 200 for seededSiteId.
Copy SMARTPARK_OPERATOR_PASSWORD from the repository root .env. Never commit the real value.
Seeded demo Driver (DataSeeder). Used only to prove the operator-only scope routes reject a non-operator role (403).
Seeded demo driver password, already public in the repository source (DataSeeder). No new secret is committed.
Seeded demo Admin (SMARTPARK_ADMIN_EMAIL). Optional; the operational layout treats admin as telemetry-visible.
Copy SMARTPARK_ADMIN_PASSWORD from the repository root .env. Never commit the real value.
Stored by request 0.1 (POST /api/auth/login).
Stored by request 0.2. Required by the scope reads, the operational layout as an assigned operator, and the walk-in gate routes.
Stored by request 0.3. Used only by the 403 role-mismatch cases.
Stored by request 0.4. Optional.

Copy SMARTPARK_SERVICE_KEY from the repository root .env (compose maps it to Services__Key). Required as the X-Service-Key header for every /internal/** route. The key must be at least 32 characters or the service refuses to start.
Generated by request 0.1; makes the walk-in plate values unique per run.
Generated by request 0.1 as SP244-<runSuffix>; used by 2.1-2.4.
Generated by request 0.1 as SP244P-<runSuffix>; used by the 6.2 latency probe.
Seeded demo site DEMO-HQ (scripts/seed-demo-site.ps1). It already has a floor, a zone and 48 AVAILABLE slots, so the read-only snapshot and the claim/release cases do not need to create structure.
Seeded demo tenant. Required in the body of the internal claim/release routes.
Seeded demo FLOOR id (reference only).
Seeded demo ZONE id (Zone A). Every seeded slot belongs to this zone.
A well-formed site id that is not assigned to the demo operator and does not exist in the demo tenant. Used for the 403 OPERATOR_LOT_UNASSIGNED and 404 SITE_NOT_FOUND cases.
Stored by request 2.1 from data.id; read back in 2.2 and checked out in 2.4.
Stored by request 6.2 from data.id; checked out in 6.4.
Epoch milliseconds set by the 6.2 pre-request script; read by 6.3 to compute the write-to-read elapsed time.
Stored by request 3.2 from the internal claim response id; used by 3.3-3.6.
Stored by request 3.2 from the internal claim response code.
Stored by request 1.1 as the first slots[] entry; used for reference only.
Stored by request 4.1 from the first metrics.zoneCapacities[] entry; used by 4.2.
Stored by request 1.1 from data.generatedAt.
Stored by request 6.1 from pm.response.responseTime (REST read proxy only).
Computed by request 6.3 as Date.now() - probeWriteAt (REST write-to-read proxy only, not the SignalR delivery latency).
